items.en: Why Does russia Need DF-3 Gadyuka Jet-Powered Interceptor Drone With 800 km Range, How Could It Actually Be Used? (Defense Express)

items.en: Russian firm DOFA-Tek unveils DF-1 'Roscherk' jet-powered drone interceptor (claimed 500 km/h)
items.nl: Russisch bedrijf DOFA-Tek presenteert straalaangedreven drone-interceptor DF-1 'Rosjtsjerk' (geclaimd 500 km/u)
items.sEn: According to the Russian state news agency TASS, the Russian company DOFA-Tek presented a jet-powered drone interceptor, the DF-1 "Roscherk", at the All-Russian Drone Congress 2026 in St Petersburg (7–9 October). The company claims a top speed of 500 km/h, a range of about 250 km and an endurance of up to 50 minutes.…
